events.title: Beijing consolidates as the imperial capital
events.summary: The city's palace, walls, and ceremonial axis make Beijing the clearest built expression of imperial central power in north China.
events.impact_line: Explains why Beijing defines state authority more directly than any other flagship city in v1.

events.title: Xi'an concentrates the long capital tradition
events.summary: As Chang'an, Xi'an gathers court politics, frontier command, and cosmopolitan exchange into one western capital landscape.
events.impact_line: Explains why Xi'an is the flagship entry for Shaanxi's deep-dive city layer.

events.title: Chengdu secures the southwest basin
events.summary: Chengdu's irrigated basin and protected geography turn it into a durable inland capital and relief center for the southwest.
events.impact_line: Explains Chengdu's recurring resilience across dynastic transition.

events.title: Hangzhou becomes the Southern Song capital and Jiangnan showcase
events.summary: Hangzhou fuses court life, lake landscape, and commercial abundance into one of the most recognizable urban identities in Chinese history.
events.impact_line: Explains why Hangzhou matters both as a capital and as a model Jiangnan city.

events.title: Guangzhou anchors the maritime gateway
events.summary: Guangzhou endures as the southern customs and port city where overseas exchange becomes part of imperial governance.
events.impact_line: Explains Guangzhou's role as the flagship city for maritime China.
